facts.did: 在生物学塔上层环带的实验森林里向 Gardenpath 报喜自己通过了考试（原以为 Plumline 会放逐自己）
facts.anchor: I can’t believe I passed! I was sure Plumline
“I’m not going to change their name.”

facts.did: 说明不改名的理由：Plumline 直接问过自己是否做文化研究，自己答了“没有”
facts.anchor: asked me directly if I was doing cultural studies

facts.did: 说自己行星勘查时见过许多其他 Unnamed 城市，文化明显不同，但没机会研究
facts.anchor: I observed many other Unnamed cities

facts.did: 宣布拿到 doctorate 后立刻离开 Memory，不留下
facts.anchor: As soon as I get my doctorate I’m out.

facts.did: 转告 Gardenpath：Plumline 已选其为自己下一个 advisee
facts.anchor: They’ve chosen you to be their next advisee.

facts.did: 发来短信祝贺 Gardenpath 通过第二次考试
facts.anchor: Arch congratulating them on passing the Second

facts.did: 在 Gardenpath 难以融入集群时软化下来，传出半梦的想法“It’s going to be OK”
facts.anchor: It’s going to be OK, Gardenpath. I promise.

relations.relation: 两人无言同行、只交换亲近感
relations.anchor: exchanging nothing but a sense of closeness

relations.relation: Oriel 将继续与 Column 共事
relations.anchor: I’m going to keep working with Column.

relations.relation: Gardenpath 打算请 Professor Arch 当自己的导师
relations.anchor: I’m going to ask Professor Arch. They made my exam

relations.relation: Plumline 选中 Gardenpath 做其下一个 advisee（指派导师关系）
relations.anchor: They’ve chosen you to be their next advisee.

relations.relation: Wainscot 无视 Oriel，把全部眼睛对准 Gardenpath 说话
relations.anchor: Wainscot ignored them, training all eyes on Gardenpath.

numbers.fact: Plumline Lab 据信在过去三十二代中训出的 investigator 比任何实验室都多
numbers.anchor: of any lab in the past thirty-two generations

numbers.fact: Oriel 说或许一两代人后会有人弄清 Unnamed 的名字
numbers.anchor: somebody will figure it out, in a generation or two.
